last_round.quote: The round includes a total of 30 funds and angels, including the likes of Sequoia Capital India, Blackbird, Folklore and Skip Capital, as well as Y Combinator, Starburst Ventures and founders and engineers from companies like Cruise, Waymo, Open AI, SpaceX and Virgin Galactic.

note: Product has evolved from ML training-pipeline speedup (2022 YC launch) to a GPU/LLM FinOps spend-management SaaS plus a legacy managed GPU training platform ('ISC'), per the provider's own card. No priced round after the 2022 seed was found in the time budget; treat total funding as a lower bound.
